senses.gloss: sādharma (nt.; to Skt. sadharma plus -a), = (if not error for) Skt. sādharmya, likeness, resemblance: Laṅk 〔110.9, 10〕; 〔276.1〕.

sādhu, m.c. sādhū and rarely sādho, indecl. (in Pali recognized by Childers and PTSD as mg. please; āyācane Pv comm. 〔232.9〕; with impv. or equivalent; I think they are right, but also that the same mg. applies in many Skt. cases, incl. most of those listed BR s.v. 5e), please, with impv. or equivalent: SP 〔34.4〕 (tat sādhu bhagavān nirdiśatu): 〔71.4〕; 〔164.13〕; 〔171.12〕; 〔180.12〕; 〔297.5〕, etc.; LV 〔6.16〕; 〔57.1〕; 〔78.15〕; 〔233.1〕, etc.; Mv 〔i.254.18〕; 〔ii.257.14〕; 〔258.14〕; 〔259.2〕; 〔iii.91.4〕; 〔300.13, 19〕; Divy 〔335.27〕; Jm 〔110.2〕; 〔157.10〕; Av 〔i.90.13〕, etc. (I see nothing un-Sanskritic in the use of sādhu Mv 〔i.174.4 ff.〕, and consequently no need for Senartʼs note); sādhū, sādho, m.c., 〔§§ 3.21, 71〕.
sādhukam, adv. (= Pali id.; Skt. sādhu), well, properly, effectively: ˚kam uttiṣṭhāmīti gātrāṇy abhisaṃskurvann avakubjaḥ prāpataṃ LV 〔256.3〕 (prose).
Sādhuprabha, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.140.7〕.
Sādhurūpa, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.138.3〕.
